title: CIP: Combine connection structs
description:
Notes:
1. There are no functionality changes with this delivery
2. This change is to reduce manual copying between structs. This will make it easier to add upcoming feature changes, and fix some connection handling issues (future merge requests).
3. Combine enip_conn_val_t and cip_conn_info_t. Previously, there were 2 different structs to track information about an overall CIP Connection.

notes.body:
This commit (0e2cd329e3c25246d426f7f238714accdea13e2c) has a line that has broken macOS builds.

```
../epan/dissectors/packet-cipmotion.c:2173:33: error: suggest braces around initialization of subobject [-Werror,-Wmissing-braces]
   cip_conn_info_t conn_info = {0};
                                ^
                                {}
1 error generated.
```
@jim.young Where can I find a build output for Mac? So, I can check that there were no other similar failures.

@jim.young @Lekensteyn There was a similar issue here: https://code.wireshark.org/review/#/c/30808. But, Peter submitted this change that should have addressed it: https://code.wireshark.org/review/#/c/30968. It looks like the check no longer triggers for the version of Clang that is used here?

@daulis0 The clang specific issues triggered by this commit were resolved Sunday with by @martin.r.mathieson with commit a7c8da4216d906bf07ebc4ea5a94a7dbe36881db . If you are interested you can drill into the macos buildbot reports at: https://buildbot.wireshark.org/wireshark-master/builders/macOS%2010.14%20x64 . Another discussion about the `error: suggest braces around initialization of subobject` message is available here: https://code.wireshark.org/review/#/c/33957/ .
